<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_hr_core_pdf_template_mapping">
    <sn_hr_core_pdf_template_mapping action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <active>true</active>
        <advanced_script_toggle>true</advanced_script_toggle>
        <box_height/>
        <box_width/>
        <date_offset_quantity>0</date_offset_quantity>
        <date_offset_type>on</date_offset_type>
        <date_offset_units>days</date_offset_units>
        <doc_left/>
        <doc_top/>
        <document display_value="LAB1070-ExtraPage">627ebc208721699050d2eca73cbb357a</document>
        <document_field>doc_1_Content</document_field>
        <document_field_label>doc_1_Content</document_field_label>
        <document_field_type>text</document_field_type>
        <mapping_field/>
        <mapping_table>x_hccc_hoc_ohs_investigation_case</mapping_table>
        <page_number/>
        <preview_value>Extra_page</preview_value>
        <script><![CDATA[(function evaluateMappingFieldValue(caseGr /* GlideRecord for parent case */, mappingField /* Pre-computed mapping field value */) {
	var content = "";
	var ohsmUtils = new x_hccc_hoc_ohs.HoCOHSMUtils();
	var formattedObject;
	var temp = "";
	
	//3. Location of incident
	try{
		temp = ohsmUtils.getLocationString(caseGr) || "";
		if ((temp.match(/\n/g) || []).length >= 2){ // when more 1 carriage return it doesn't fit in main field
			content+="Section 3: Site of hazardous occurence:\n";
			content+= temp;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}
	

	//4. Description of what happened
	try{
		temp = caseGr.getValue("mng_inc_desc") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 3);
		if(!formattedObject.inputFits){
		//if (caseGr.getValue("mng_inc_desc").length > 303){
			content+="Section 4: Description of what happened:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	//4. Brief description and estimated cost of property damage
	try{
		temp = caseGr.getValue("brief_description_and_estimated_cost") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 2);
		if(!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 4: Brief description and estimated cost of property damage:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}

	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	try{
		//5. Description of Injury
		temp = caseGr.getValue("mng_desc_injury") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 60, 2);
		if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 5: Description of injury:\n";
			content+= formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	try{
		//Was training in accident prevention / Specify
		temp = caseGr.getValue("training_spec") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 50, 2);
		if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 5: Was training in accident prevention given / Specify:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	// try{	
	// 	//6. Direct cause of hazardous occurence
	// 	temp = caseGr.getValue("direct_causes_of_hazardous_occurrence") || "";
	// 	formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 3);
	// 	if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
	// 		content+="Section 6: Direct cause of hazardous occurrence:\n";
	// 		content+=formattedObject.input;
	// 		content+="\n\n";
	// 	}
	// }catch(err){
	// 	gs.debug(err.message);
	// }

	try{	
		//7. Corrective measures and date employer will implement
		temp = ohsmUtils.getMeasuresAndDate(caseGr, "correct_meas_imp_date", "implementation_date") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 2);
		if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 7: Corrective measures and date employer will implement:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	try{	
		//Reasons for not taking corrective measures
		temp = caseGr.getValue("no_correct_meas_reas") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 2);
		if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 7: Reasons for not taking corrective measures:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	try{
        //7. Supplementary preventative measures 
		temp = caseGr.getValue("supplementary_preventative_measures") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 2);
		if(!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 7: Supplementary preventative measures:\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}

	try{	
		//Section 9: Work place committee or health and safety representative comments
		temp = caseGr.getValue("whsc_comments") || "";
		formattedObject = ohsmUtils.getFieldFormattedString(temp, 100, 2);
		if (!formattedObject.inputFits){
			content+="Section 9: Work place committee or health and safety representative comments\n";
			content+=formattedObject.input;
			content+="\n\n";
		}
	}catch(err){
		gs.debug(err.message);
	}
	
	return content;
})(caseGr, mappingField);]]></script>
